channel.title: Mythwake News
channel.description: News and patch notes for Mythwake, an online 2D RPG.

item.title: Monsters Fight Back
item.description:
Monsters are harder to cheese and quests show up on your maps. Thanks to everyone who reported what felt off. Keep the reports coming through Menu > Report a bug.

There's a new launcher. Download it from https://playmythwake.com/download and use it in place of the old one: it shows when the game is under maintenance and has the new look.

Highlights

  • Stronger monsters pay more XP. One-hitting a Lv 1 no longer pays like fighting something your own level.
  • Quest markers. A gold "?" on the minimap and world map shows where each quest goes next.
  • Monsters fight back. Packs hit much harder, and a monster that gives up the chase keeps its wounds.
  • A new look. A barber and a clothier have opened in Tolvadden, with eight new hairstyles.
  • Fish and feast. Fishing has its own net and rod animations, and animals drop meat to cook: six new foods from Cooking 1 to 30.
  • Crafting is a real climb. Forging, Woodworking, Tailoring and Alchemy pay by the materials you use and take several times longer to level.
